Name: Jaazaniah, Son of Jeremiah
Summary: Jaazaniah, son of Jeremiah (a different Jeremiah from the prophet), was a Rechabite whom Jeremiah brought into the temple chamber and tested with wine; Jaazaniah and his brothers refused, holding to Jonadab's command to drink no wine and build no houses. He is a different man from Jaazaniah son of Shaphan and Jaazaniah son of Azur.
KeyStory: Jeremiah set bowls of wine before Jaazaniah and the Rechabites, and they answered that Jonadab their father had commanded them to drink no wine for ever.
LifeLesson: Obedience kept for generations can shame a whole nation that will not obey for a day.
